info.name: Application - Negotiation Agent
info.description:
Negotiation agent: eunomia RPC on both sides, the management API and the DSP endpoints.

Set `ContractNegotiationProvider` and `ContractNegotiationConsumer` in the environment and `providerDid`, `consumerDid`, `policyId` and `datasetId` (a published offer and its dataset) here. RPC continuations take `@id`, each agent's own process id, captured by the tests.
